verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant, for example in the Dashboard, is a plausible capability for a payments platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no in-product assistant users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server serves external IDE agents, agentic commerce lets shoppers pay through ChatGPT or Google AI, and AI-driven payment optimization is an automated feature rather than an assistant; none of these transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
